metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows a decompression exercise that can give lower back pain relief within seconds.

This exercise requires only a soup can, and will help take pressure off spinal discs quickly. This may also help with sciatica and pinched nerve pain.

Let us know how it works for you!
